name: Lead Sync – Divi 5 to Jetpack CRM
author: Jahidur Nadim

sections.description:
Transform your Divi 5 Contact Forms into a powerful lead generation machine!

Lead Sync – Divi 5 to Jetpack CRM is the ultimate solution for businesses using Divi 5 theme and Jetpack CRM. This plugin creates a seamless bridge between your website’s contact forms and your customer relationship management system, ensuring no lead ever falls through the cracks.

🚀 Key Features

  • Automatic Lead Sync – Every Divi 5 contact form submission instantly creates a lead in Jetpack CRM
  • Zero Configuration – Works out of the box with no setup required
  • Smart Field Mapping – Automatically maps form fields to CRM customer data
  • Custom Field Support – Handles both standard and custom form fields
  • Duplicate Prevention – Updates existing contacts instead of creating duplicates
  • Error Logging – Built-in logging for troubleshooting and monitoring
  • Developer Friendly – Includes hooks and filters for customization
  • Secure & Reliable – WordPress coding standards compliant with proper sanitization

💼 Perfect for Business Growth

Transform casual website visitors into trackable leads with this powerful integration. Whether you’re a:

  • Digital Marketing Agency – Streamline client lead management
  • Small Business Owner – Never miss a potential customer
  • E-commerce Store – Convert inquiries into sales opportunities
  • Service Provider – Organize client communications effectively

🔧 How It Works

  1. Install & Activate – No configuration needed
  2. Create Divi Contact Forms – Use Divi 5’s powerful contact form module
  3. Watch Leads Flow – Form submissions automatically appear in Jetpack CRM
  4. Manage & Convert – Use Jetpack CRM’s tools to nurture leads into customers

📊 Supported Form Fields

  • Name – Automatically splits into first and last name
  • Email – Validates and syncs as primary contact method
  • Phone – Adds to mobile phone field in CRM
  • Subject – Included in lead notes for context
  • Message – Full message content preserved in CRM notes
  • Custom Fields – Any additional fields are captured in lead notes

🛡️ Security & Reliability

  • Full WordPress security compliance
  • Data sanitization and validation
  • Error handling with detailed logging
  • Compatible with WordPress multisite
  • Regular updates and maintenance

🔗 Integration Requirements

This plugin requires both:
* Jetpack CRM (Free CRM plugin)
* Divi Theme with Divi 5 or Divi Builder Plugin

🎯 SEO Benefits

By streamlining your lead management process, you can:
* Respond faster to customer inquiries
* Improve customer satisfaction scores
* Increase conversion rates from leads to customers
* Build better customer relationships through organized data

💡 Pro Tips

  • Use descriptive form field names for better organization in CRM
  • Set up Jetpack CRM automations to follow up with new leads
  • Create different forms for different lead sources to track performance
  • Use Divi’s conditional logic for advanced form functionality

🌟 Why Choose Lead Sync?

Unlike complex CRM integrations that require technical setup, Lead Sync works instantly. It’s designed specifically for the Divi + Jetpack CRM combination, ensuring perfect compatibility and reliable performance.

Start capturing and managing leads more effectively today!
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation (Recommended)

  1. Login to your WordPress admin dashboard
  2. Navigate to Plugins → Add New
  3. Search for “Lead Sync Divi Jetpack CRM”
  4. Click Install Now and then Activate
  5. That’s it! The plugin will start working immediately

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin zip file
  2. Login to your WordPress admin dashboard
  3. Navigate to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin
  4. Choose the downloaded zip file and click Install Now
  5. Click Activate Plugin

Requirements Check

After activation, ensure you have:
* Jetpack CRM plugin installed and activated
* Divi theme (with Divi 5) or Divi Builder plugin active

If either requirement is missing, you’ll see an admin notice with instructions.

Setup Verification

  1. Create a test Divi contact form on any page
  2. Submit the form with test data
  3. Check your Jetpack CRM → Contacts to see the new lead
  4. If the lead appears, you’re all set!
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work with older Divi versions?

This plugin is specifically designed for Divi 5. For maximum compatibility and features, we recommend using the latest version of Divi.

Will it sync existing form submissions?

No, the plugin only syncs new form submissions made after activation. It does not retroactively import historical form data.

Can I customize which fields are synced?

Yes! The plugin includes developer hooks and filters. Use the lsdjc_jetpack_crm_data filter to modify the data before it’s sent to Jetpack CRM.

What happens if I have duplicate email addresses?

The plugin intelligently updates existing contacts instead of creating duplicates, helping keep your CRM clean and organized.

Does it work with Jetpack CRM’s free version?

Yes! The plugin works perfectly with the free version of Jetpack CRM. Premium features of Jetpack CRM will enhance the experience but aren’t required.

Can I disable the plugin temporarily?

Yes, simply deactivate the plugin and form submissions will stop syncing to Jetpack CRM. Your existing CRM data remains untouched.

Is there any configuration required?

No configuration is needed! The plugin works automatically once activated, as long as you have both Jetpack CRM and Divi installed.

What about GDPR compliance?

The plugin only processes data that users voluntarily submit through your contact forms. Ensure your forms include appropriate privacy notices and consent mechanisms as required by GDPR.

Does it support multisite installations?

Yes, the plugin is compatible with WordPress multisite networks. Activate it on individual sites where you want the sync functionality.

How can I troubleshoot sync issues?

The plugin logs all sync attempts. Check your WordPress error logs or use a debugging plugin to view detailed error messages if leads aren’t syncing properly.
